attributes.name: ypy-sort
attributes.description: On a list container: its children that have an `id` can be reordered by dragging them, or with the keyboard (Space picks an item up and puts it down, the arrow keys move it, Escape puts everything back). `false` leaves the container to the page.

values.name: false
values.description: The extension does not touch this container.

attributes.name: ypy-sort-url
attributes.description: The URL that gets a POST when an item is dropped in a new place: the field `id` once per item, in the new order. An answer of 400 or more, or a connection that fails, puts the list back. Without it the list only reorders.

events.name: ypy:sort:change
events.description: Fires on the container when an item was put down in a new place, before the order is sent. Cancel it to put the list back.

events.name: ypy:sort:revert
events.description: Fires on the container after the list was put back in its old order: the change was cancelled, the server refused it or did not answer, or the drag was abandoned.

config.name: sort.messages
config.description: What the live region says while a list is sorted with the keyboard: `grab`, `move`, `drop`, `cancel` and `revert`, each a text where `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced. A message that is not set is not said.

config.name: sort.messages.grab
config.description: What is said when a list item is picked up; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced.

config.name: sort.messages.move
config.description: What is said when a picked up item is moved; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced.

config.name: sort.messages.drop
config.description: What is said when an item is put down; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced.

config.name: sort.messages.cancel
config.description: What is said when a pick up is cancelled with Escape; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced.

config.name: sort.messages.revert
config.description: What is said when the list is put back after a refusal; `{position}` and `{total}` are replaced.
